literal_meaning: গরুর ধুলো (cow dust, referring to the dust raised by cows returning home at dusk)
figurative_meaning_en: Twilight or sunset time; end of life or old age
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনের গোধূলিতে সে শান্তিতে কাটাতে চায়।
গোধূলির সময় নদীর ধারে বসে স্মৃতি মনে পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: He wants to spend the twilight of his life in peace.
Memories flood back while sitting by the river at twilight.
history: Originating from rural Bengali life, evoking the image of cows returning home at dusk, raising dust in the fading light, a common motif in classical Bengali literature.
note: Often used metaphorically in poetry to denote transience and reflection.
